title: Chapter 576
text:
"How did Black Star get the Golden Gal Badge?"

At this moment, countless galactic residents were shocked and filled with doubts.

The news of Han Xiao 'defeating' Dark-star had not completely died down, and many people still remembered his identity and deeds. If the badge was given to an unknown person, most people would only feel that it was mysterious and curious. However, when it was given to a person who had already formed an impression in their hearts, most people were shocked!

Pairs of dazed eyes stared at Han Xiao as he stood in front of Serbia the Fifth, facing the highest leader of Godora.

Serbia the Fifth changed his tone into a solemn one and said loudly, "Don't worry.

"Black Star is the key person who provided Dark-star's coordinates. He is the biggest contributor to eliminating Dark-star this time. He is bold and meticulous, and he used some method to crack Dark-star's database, breaking the concealment ability that Dark-star relied on to survive, allowing us to monitor the enemy's coordinates … Without him, we would not have won!"

Black Star was the key person who provided the information?

Hearing this news, countless people were enlightened.

The doubtful gazes of Godora's people suddenly changed to surprise, admiration, gratitude, and respect.

The various Army Commanders were suddenly enlightened. No wonder Black Star was favored by Godora. Everything made sense now.

It turned out that this war employment was actually single-handedly facilitated by Black Star, and the Army Commanders were the ones who reaped the benefits!

Justin could not help but blush, feeling that he had made a big joke of himself.

When Black Star was questioned by him, he was probably mocking him in his heart.

On the other side, the reporters were stunned for a moment before realizing the crux of the matter.

Dark-star appeared and disappeared mysteriously, but Black Star provided their coordinates. In reality, he was the root cause of Dark-star's destruction!

He started this war single-handedly! He changed the power structure of the Garton Star System!

Rather than saying that Godora had used Black Star's information to defeat Dark-star, it would be better to say that Black Star had used Godora's hand to eliminate the enemy that had attacked his hometown!

This kind of person … is so scary!

Countless inspirations burst forth, and many reporters were overjoyed. They buried their heads and wrote furiously.

Han Xiao received the attention of the audience on stage. The camera broadcast his handsome face to the virtual screens of every household in Godora.

The impact this time had a chemical reaction with the news of defeating Dark-star not long ago. The effect could be said to be sensational. Han Xiao's appearance and deeds were imprinted in the hearts of countless Interstellar viewers. They had a deep impression of him, and they wouldn't be able to forget him even if they wanted to.

It was a pity that there was no speech arranged for the award ceremony. Otherwise, he would have wanted to show off his skills. Now, he could only stand on the stage and be a mascot receiving praise.

The awarding ceremony had a formal and solemn process. After going through the ceremony, Serbia the Fifth received a golden medal from a special person. It was engraved with the image of Gower.

He personally bestowed the medal and solemnly pinned it on Han Xiao's chest.

"On behalf of Godora, I thank you for your contribution."

Han Xiao suddenly felt like an Olympic champion receiving a gold medal. He reached out and touched the Golden Gower Medal. He suddenly had the urge to bite it to see if it was gold-plated.

After receiving Godora's highest honor, he couldn't possibly not react at all. Logically speaking, he should be thanking Godora and the like. However, Han Xiao thought about it and reached out to shake Serbia the Fifth's hand. He put on a 'sincere' smile and said, "We have a good working relationship.

Our Black Star Corps accepts all legal employment. We operate with integrity and never go back on our words. If you choose Black Star, you can rest assured for the rest of your life … Oh, and may our friendship with Godora last forever. "

From Han Xiao's understanding, the bigger the occasion, the more suitable it was to advertise. He was not Godora's subordinate, and it was such a good opportunity. It was pointless to say such polite words of thanks. As the saying went, as long as one was brave enough, one could produce 18,000 wheat per mu.

Furthermore, Godora couldn't possibly take back the medal in front of so many people. Hahaha!

F * ck, you're actually advertising on such a grand occasion … The smile on Serbia the Fifth's face froze. The curse was stuck in his throat, but he swallowed it back down and forced himself to maintain his smile.

I am the supreme leader of Godora. I cannot use vulgarities …

Pa … All the army commanders facepalmed. We are all in the same industry, but you are still the one who is bold enough to advertise.

"You are indeed my teacher. Even when you are shameless, you are still so handsome." Sylvia's eyes sparkled.

Hila suddenly felt a sense of relief. This person had not changed at all. He was still the same!

Click, click, click …

Countless cameras captured the scene of the two of them shaking hands. It was as if it was engraved in the long river of time.

In the eyes of the players, this scene seemed to have the weight of an epic. Looking at Han Xiao, who had just mentioned the Black Star Army, many players suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of excitement and pride, as though they shared the same glory.

Galaxy Calendar, Year 692, May 25th.

Godora launched a full-scale counterattack against Dark-star. Dark-star was destroyed, and Black Star, as the key intelligence source, almost single-handedly changed the structure of the Garton Star System. The Black Star Corps also participated in [Hodelias]'s counterattack.

In June of the same year, Black Star was personally awarded the Golden Gal Badge by Godora's supreme leader, Serbia the Fifth. He was the first person in history who was not a Godora to receive this honor.

Time seemed to have stopped, and everything was recorded in history.

The Shattered Star Ring was shaken!

…

After the official ceremony, it was a celebration for the entire civilization. The people celebrated the destruction of Dark-star.

After the ceremony, Han Xiao boarded the official aircraft and returned to the guest house with the other Army Commanders under Serbia the Fifth's resentful gaze.

Along the way, Gureja, Underworld Feather, and more than ten other Army Commanders came to talk to him.

After the award ceremony, everyone knew that the Black Star Corps was the one who had benefited the most this time. They had completely made a name for themselves and would definitely have endless missions in the future. Han Xiao's position in their hearts had increased by a few levels, and they tried to get close to him whenever they had the chance.

The spaceship stopped at the guest house, and Han Xiao hurriedly got rid of the crowd and returned to his room.

After closing the door, Han Xiao took a sip of water and took a deep breath before taking out the Golden Gal Badge and looking at it.

The item description popped up on the interface.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

"This badge has changed so many initial relationships. It has saved me at least four to five years of time to gain Favorability."

The increase in initial relationships meant that his face had increased, and he could get the Black Star Corps to accept employment in more places.

The business model that he had set for the Black Star Corps required NPC resource lands the most. The increase brought by this badge had saved him a lot of effort.

Han Xiao looked at the interface. Other than the effect of the badge, there were more notifications. The official announcement of the destruction of Dark-star had also been made. [Godora's Ally] Mission Completed.

[Godora's Ally] has been completed. Your completed targets are [Deputy Leader – Degulish], [Wind Demon – Anur], [Captured Mothership], [Assault Spaceship Destroyer] …

Mission Rating: Unbelievable

Character Summon Card – Dark-star Leader: [Heart Curse – Collapse] – Inflicts [Mental Collapse] on a single target. If the target passes, the target will lose control of their body and will not be able to do anything. Effect and duration depend on the 'MYS' attribute. Usages: 0/2

Character Summon Card – Nagojin: [Secret Technique – Muscles Are Truth] – + 250 STR, + 40% Melee Damage, Duration: 3 minutes. Usages: 0/7

"Muscles Are Truth? What kind of skill name is this? "

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Why was it so philosophical? Why didn't it say that Muscles Are Truth?

He continued to save up the Random Rewards. Without a certain number, he did not want to randomly draw them. Furthermore, there was no need to rely on luck now.

Then, Han Xiao looked at the dungeon interface. After completing the main storyline mission with a high rating, a new dungeon had indeed been created.

[Godora and Dark-star]!

The new dungeon was similar to [Six Nations and Germinal Organization]. It would cut out the battle scenes of the main storyline mission to form a dungeon crystal. It basically materialized the enemies of [Godora's Ally] and turned them into small dungeons for the players to challenge. For example, Anur, Degulish, a fixed number of Dark-star warriors, elite warriors, and assault ships, and so on.

It meant that every strong Dark-star enemy that he defeated would become a model worker.

However, the current players could only be abused, so the new dungeon was not used yet.

The rewards were still quite impressive.

After sorting out the mission rewards, Han Xiao looked at the other notifications on the interface.

As he expected, such a sensational legendary event had indeed received a new Legendary Point.

Furthermore, it was not one point but two!

Star System Legendary Point (Garton Star System): Dark-star Destroyer — Dark-star is Godora's natural enemy, a terrorist organization that does evil. Both sides have been in a stalemate for many years, but you brought about a turning point and changed the power structure by yourself. Because of your help, Godora successfully destroyed Dark-star. Dark-star has become history, and your legend will be praised and praised. The world will revere you, and your enemies will be terrified.

"What a surprise." Han Xiao rubbed his hands excitedly.

Legendary Points were not easy to obtain, and he had originally thought that he would only get one point. He did not expect to receive two Star System Legendary Points, which was a twenty-four percent increase. The potential benefits of Legendary Points were naturally greater.

'Dark-star Destroyer' came from destroying Dark-star, while 'Godora's Ally' came from the honor of the Golden Gal Badge and the [Godora's Ally] mission. They were separated into two separate achievements.

"After a few days of news, my fame will skyrocket, and the reputation of the Black Star Corps will rise to a terrifying level. Employers with or without money will all come to me."

Han Xiao was overjoyed.

His reputation in the Garton Star System had skyrocketed, and he could practically do whatever he wanted in this Star System.

His next goal was to strengthen his reputation while expanding, which would allow the players to officially start their mercenary career.

"The award ceremony is over, so there's no need to stay on Godora's mother planet. I'll rest for a night and receive fifty spaceships tomorrow before bringing the players to Base No.1. on Planet Golden Gate."

Han Xiao made a plan in his heart.

…

At the edge of the Shattered Star Ring, on a desolate planet.

A spaceship hovered in the air, collecting gaseous fuel from the planet. There were only two people on the spaceship — the Dark-star leader and Ashes.

At this moment, in the control room, the virtual screen had just finished broadcasting Godora's ceremony, and Han Xiao's award ceremony was also seen by the two of them.

There was a deathly silence.

The Dark-star leader and Ashes' faces stiffened, and they finally understood why they had lost so badly.

…
